![Mizuno's x Farmer's Delight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80b3a2f2d82a7c8e2bd74d0a9bbd7875ccb95a3c_0.webp)

這是一個材質包，讓 Mizuno 能夠與 Farmer's Delight 相容。 我使用的是 Farmer's Delight Refabricated。它可能也適用於 Farmer's Delight (Forge)，因為我並未使用 Forge。

**需求**：[Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated)
**我的所有 Mizuno 附加模組** - [Mizuno Better Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-better-leaves) - [Unofficial Mizuno's](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/unofficial-mizunos) - [Mizuno Connected Texture](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-connected-texture) -
